salary-breakup.g: Every employee's salary from their CTC, component by component
salary-breakup.w: One row per active employee: CTC, every earning (Basic, HRA, allowances), gross, every deduction (PF, ESI, PT), net take-home, every employer contribution (PF, ESI, NPS) and cost to company. Worked out by the same engine a payroll close uses, from the Salary Structure rules in Organization Configuration that win for that person — company, branch and its city/state, department, designation, team, gender or the employee — at a full month with no loss of pay. A Difference column flags anyone whose cost to company does not add back to their CTC. Click a name to see the rule behind each figure.

salary-breakup.tip: To change a figure, change the rule in Organization Configuration → Salary Structure; this page follows it at once.
